name: Altitude Group plc
summary: Altitude Group plc provides technology and information solutions in North America and the United Kingdom. The company offers patented technology platform to its network with a built-in supply chain, as well as combines an e-commerce trading platform with a cloud-based CRM and order management system for business intelligence requirements; e-commerce website solutions with in-built patented online designer and pre-loaded product databases; patented online design solutions; and virtual sample services that allow personalized design on a product with imprint technique. It also provides software services, events and exhibitions, catalogues, artwork services, marketing and business administration services to distributors. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Sheffield, the United Kingdom.
